neighbours.label: the word piece 'las'/'ras' (weaker for other '-as' pieces such as 'olas', 'cas') split off inside a rare word or name: Las Vegas, Niklas, toxoplasmosis, Krasinski, idiosyncrasies; common whole words with the same letters (glass, class, grass, brass, plasma) stay quiet
neighbours.short: 'las'/'ras' word piece inside rare words and names
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 token-piece detector. It feeds the Texas neuron L1/N2546- weakly through the '-as' ending (' Texas' 0.19, ' Dallas' 0.29). Solver round (differential evolution over a sentence bank) found no leak; near-miss ceiling was 'Nicholas' 0.37 via the 'olas' piece, so names with an '-as' piece were kept out of the near misses. Twitch chat was quiet this mission; all sentences are the streamer's own.
